correctness.rationale: Funk-Hecke diagonalizes fixed-shell averaging on S^(d-1) (integer d>=5), with normalized Gegenbauer p_n,d(x), x=cos(theta), and L2_0 norm sup_(n>=1)|p_n,d(x)|. Low modes p1=x, p2=(dx²-1)/(d-1) give a global lower bound 1/d with possible equality only x=±1/d: if |x|<1/d then -p2>1/d; outside p1>1/d. At these candidates p1 and p2 saturate, while |p3|<1/d by its explicit expression. Exact integral p_n,d=E[x+i sqrt(1-x²)U]^n for U the first coordinate of a uniform tangent (d-1)-sphere, together with |Z|<=1 and E|Z|^4=(3d+2)/d³<1/d, bounds all n>=4 simultaneously (no finite-degree truncation). Parity covers x<0, multiplicities d and d(d+1)/2-1 follow standard harmonic dimensions, and self-adjoint powers give d^(-k) at the same unique pair of angles. Independently checked normalized recurrence and fourth-moment identity algebraically, reviewed exact source tree and full checker; checker dimensions <=100 and modes <=160 corroborate but do not establish universal quantifiers.
